shellCommands.command: git status --short; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -path ./.next -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat package.json; ls

for f in pages/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js pages/blog/*.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "RouteContext" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "unstable_retry\|global-not-found" node_modules/next/dist/docs -l 2>/dev/null | head

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n 1,80p 03-file-conventions/error.md; grep -n "unstable_retry\|reset" 03-file-conventions/error.md | head -30; grep -n "PageProps\|LayoutProps\|RouteContext" 05-config/02-typescript.md | head -20

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; ls 03-file-conventions; grep -n "global-not-found\|globalNotFound" -r . | head; grep -rn "cacheComponents" 03-file-conventions/route-segment-config* 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n 80,200p 03-file-conventions/error.md; grep -n -A25 "global-error" 03-file-conventions/error.md | sed -n 1,60p; grep -n -B2 -A20 "Route Context Helper\|route-context-helper" 03-file-conventions/route.md | head -40

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n 320,340p 03-file-conventions/error.md; grep -n -A20 "Page Props Helper" 03-file-conventions/page.md | head -30; grep -n "revalidate\|dynamicParams\|cacheComponents" 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/*.md | head -20; ls 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; cat 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config/index.md; ls 02-guides | head -80; grep -n "cacheComponents" 02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides; ls migrating; grep -n "revalidate\|getStaticPaths\|fallback\|isFallback\|router.back\|next/navigation" migrating/app-router-migration.md | head -50

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions; grep -n -i "metadata\|client component\|props" not-found.md | head -20; sed -n 808,860p ../../02-guides/migrating/app-router-migration.md

rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && sed -i 's/export default function Error(/export default function ErrorPage(/' app/error.tsx && grep -n "type Route\b\|export type { Route\|Route," node_modules/next/types/index.d.ts node_modules/next/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -5; npx tsc --noEmit; echo tsc=$?
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40; git diff tsconfig.json; ls
